24.verdict: behind the channel's earlier Shorts at this age: 519 views against a median of 873 (0.6x)

worked: Viewer satisfaction was strong among those who watched, achieving 3.9 likes per 100 views, outperforming nearly all earlier benchmarks at 25 hours (which averaged around 2.1 to 3.2 likes per 100).
hurt: Pacing and hook velocity lagged, with views per hour at just 20.7 (total 519 views), well below the typical 38 to 57 views per hour reached by the channel's stronger performers at 25 hours.
diagnosis.change_next: Replace descriptive statement hooks with an immediate contradiction in the first beat: open directly with 'Rings aren't supposed to exist on a rock this small' instead of 'A minor planet barely 155 miles wide is wearing icy rings.'

72.verdict: behind the channel's earlier Shorts at this age: 710 views against a median of 1018 (0.7x)

worked: The opening premise and hook text hooked feed swipers effectively, achieving a high engaged_share of 0.614 and watching_at_5 of 1.268, which converted into strong viewer appreciation with 4.9 likes_per_100 (well above the ~2.5 channel norm).
Shorts feed distribution was healthy with a feed_share of 0.955, confirming the algorithm tested the video directly in the core feed rather than stalling outside it.
hurt: Mid-script retention bled heavily, dropping from 1.268 at watching_at_5 down to 0.547 at watching_at_50 as the historical backstory and astronomer attribution (beats 2–4) slowed down the scale ladder premise.

Completion and looping fell flat with watching_at_end at 0.346 and avg_viewed at 60.98%, trailing top-performing peers (which achieve 78%–99% avg_viewed and end retention above 0.42), which capped total views at 710.
diagnosis.change_next: In beat 3, cut named credits and historical setup ('In 2013, Brazilian astronomer Felipe Braga-Ribas watched...'); replace it immediately with the sensory evidence ('When Chariklo crossed in front of a distant star, the starlight blinked twice...') to prevent the 50% retention cliff.
